evidence.r1: Only the Cascade Pass selector, weather chip and Permits pill floating over the hero photo use glass; the lower Trails/Conditions text section and the Planned Route card are opaque content, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r2: The three floating pills sit in a single row with no stacking on one another, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r3: Three glass elements total, each load-bearing (route choice, weather, permits), shot-full-light.
evidence.r4: All three pills show the same frosted regular-glass look over the photo in both shot-fv-light and shot-fv-dark.
evidence.r5: No clear-variant glass appears; the trail-list overlay (shot-menu-light) uses the same frosted treatment as the bar.
evidence.r6: None of the three floating pills carries a saturated tint distinct from neutral glass in either scheme; the purple accent lives only on the static Planned Route card, not a glass control.
evidence.r7: All three pills show blur and highlight edges over the lake photo rather than a flat fill, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r8: The three floating pills are capsules; the Planned Route card corners are a fixed radius, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r9: The checked 'Cascade Pass' row in the trail list (shot-menu-light) sits inset from the panel's own corner radius without pinching.
evidence.r10: The Cascade Pass, weather and Permits pills are all capsules; no small dense control contradicts this, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r11: Cascade Pass selector, weather chip and Permits form three separate glass groups in the one floating row, at the group limit, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r12: Each pill combines one icon with its own text as a single control (route selector, weather chip) rather than a separate text button pairing with a separate icon button, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r13: Glass is applied to each pill's outer capsule; the icon, text and chevron inside sit on one shared surface, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r14: The three floating pills keep a visible gap between each other rather than merging, shot-full-light.
evidence.r15: shot-full-light/dark are pixel-identical to shot-fv-light/dark, so no scrolled content is shown passing under the floating bar; no edge fade is demonstrated.
evidence.r16: All three pills sit over the varied lake/forest photo, never a flat field, in both schemes.
evidence.r17: Only the hero photo sits under the floating pills at rest; the text section below (Trails and conditions) is never covered by any glass, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r18: Dark text on the light pills in shot-fv-light and light text on the dark pills in shot-fv-dark both read clearly over the photo.
evidence.r19: shot-reduced only shows the transparency switch turning pills solid; no increased-contrast or reduced-motion state is captured.
evidence.r20: The lake/forest photo fills the full width of the 1440px frame with only pills floating over it, shot-fv-light/dark; the content section below also spans full width with no side panel.
evidence.r21: The photo extends edge-to-edge behind the floating bar with no sidebar and no hard seam, shot-full-light/dark.
evidence.r22: The trail-list overlay (shot-menu-light/dark) adds no dark scrim behind it beyond its own glass panel.
evidence.r23: Only the trail list's position directly under the 'Cascade Pass' selector (shot-menu-light) can be checked from stills, not morph or press behaviour.
evidence.r24: Pill text and icons are monochrome black/white in both schemes; the only saturated colour (purple accent, green 'Open' dot) lives on the static content card, not a glass control.
evidence.r25: Black pill text over the lake's blue-green water and white pill text over the same area in dark mode both stay distinct from the backdrop hue.
